items.title: 18.10 Redox Reactions of Transition Metals (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to the redox reactions of transition metals (PDF 33).

blocks.text: Transition elements kai oxidation states mein ho sakte hain, is liye bohat se redox reactions mein hissa lete hain. Redox reaction mumkin hai ya nahi, yeh half-reactions ke standard electrode potentials (E) ke muqable se tay hota hai: E cell = E(reduction) - E(oxidation), aur agar E cell musbat ho to reaction mumkin hai. Amalan zyada musbat E wala species reduce hota (electrons leta) aur kam musbat wala oxidise hota (electrons khota) hai.

blocks.alt: Volt ke paimane par electrode potentials ki seerhi: MnO4- + 8H+ + 5e- -> Mn2+ + 4H2O (+1.52 V), Fe3+ + e- -> Fe2+ (+0.77 V), I2 + 2e- -> 2I- (+0.54 V), Cu2+ + e- -> Cu+ (+0.15 V) aur 2CO2 + 2e- -> C2O4 2- (-0.49 V). Oopar ka teer taqatwar oxidising agent ki simt hai.
blocks.caption: Topics 18.10.1 se 18.10.3 ke electrode potentials (is topic ke liye asal khaaka; kitab mein figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Jitna oopar, utna zyada musbat E aur utna taqatwar oxidising agent; oopar wala couple reduce hota hai aur neeche wala oxidise. Kitab CO2/C2O4 2- ke liye +0.49 V chhaapti hai; data tables taqreeban -0.49 V dete hain, jo yahan dikhaya gaya hai. MnO4- aur Fe2+: E cell = 1.52 - 0.77 = +0.75 V. Cu2+ aur I-: E cell = 0.15 - 0.54 = -0.39 V, phir bhi CuI ke precipitate banne se reaction aage chalta hai.

blocks.prompt: Kisi reaction ka E cell = +0.75 V hai. Kya yeh mumkin hai?
blocks.explanation: Haan; musbat E cell ka matlab hai ke reaction standard halaat mein mumkin hai.

items: E cell = E(reduction) - E(oxidation); musbat yani mumkin.
Zyada musbat E: reduce; kam musbat: oxidise.
